questions.q: Given below are two statements: Statement I: Bromination of phenol in solvent with low polarity such as CHCl3 or CS2 requires Lewis acid catalyst. Statement II: The Lewis acid catalyst polarises the bromine to generate Br+. Choose the correct answer.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
questions.explain: Phenol is sufficiently activated for direct bromination without a Lewis acid.

questions.q: Phenol treated with chloroform in presence of sodium hydroxide, which is further hydrolysed in presence of an acid, results in:
questions.explain: Reimer-Tiemann reaction gives ortho-formylation of phenol, yielding 2-hydroxybenzaldehyde.

questions.q: The difference in the reaction of phenol with bromine in chloroform and bromine in water medium is due to:
questions.explain: Solvent polarity affects phenol ionization and bromine electrophilicity.
